# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.0.0

Version 1.0.0 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v0.1.6

- **Minimap**: outside in the town, a small map of the town sits in the bottom left corner of the screen, drawn with
  the game's own map pictures, with you (pointing the way you face) and the villagers' houses. It hides in buildings,
  on the island, during talks and events, and while a menu is open. When the game's clock moves to the bottom left,
  the minimap makes room above it. Turn it off under pause menu → Settings → Gameplay → **Minimap**.
- **Map key (M)**: **M** opens the game's town map at any time and closes it again, even before you have the map
  from the police station, and indoors too. Rebind it (or give it a gamepad button) under Settings → Controls →
  Buttons → **Map**.
- **Android**: a quick tap on the minimap opens the map, and a tap where there are no on-screen buttons closes it. The
  minimap sits where the stick starts, so a thumb that lands on it and moves steers as usual. On PC, clicking the
  minimap opens the map too.
- **Automatic updates** (from this version on): when the game starts it looks for a newer release and offers
  **Update now / Later / Skip this version**.
  - Windows / Linux: the new zip is downloaded, checked against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, its files replace the old ones in
    the game folder, and **Restart now** starts the new version. Saves, settings, the disc and the Korean disc stay as
    they are. The game folder must be writable (not inside `Program Files`); Linux needs `curl` or `wget`.
  - Android: the new APK is downloaded and checked, then the system installer opens. For this the app now asks for the
    internet and install-request permissions.
  - Turn it off under Settings → Gameplay → **Updates**.
  - **v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install v1.0.0 by hand once.**
- The pause menu shows the version.
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves and the Korean patch are kept).

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed. This build was made without any assets
  extracted from the disc; it reads them from your own disc image at run time.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (below). The Korean patch is the work of an independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to
  this repository; please send questions about the patch to its distribution page. v0.9.2 and v0.9.3 are verified.
- Tested with automated runs on Linux and with the Windows builds under Wine, but not yet much on real Windows PCs or
  Android devices. Please report problems as issues.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.0.0-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.0.0-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.0.0-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.0.0-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Running

**Windows / Linux**
1. Unzip the archive, create a `rom` folder inside the extracted `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus` folder and put the disc image in it.
   On Windows you can also pick the folder that holds the image with **Choose folder** in the prompt shown at launch.
2. Run `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus.exe` (Linux: `./DobutsuNoMoriEPlus`).
   Saves are created in `save/` in the same folder. To move over from an earlier version, copy `save/`, `rom/`,
   `korean/`, `settings.ini` and `keybindings.ini` into the new folder.

**Android**
1. Put the disc image in a folder on the phone (e.g. `Download/동물의숲`; the root of `Download` itself cannot be
   picked, so make a folder inside it).
2. Install the APK (allow apps from unknown sources), launch it, and pick that folder with **Choose folder** in the prompt.
3. Both the on-screen (touch) gamepad and physical gamepads work.
4. A release build signed with the release key (certificate SHA-256 `db6fc1ad60b6b6d980bee0990f120ef481f195f117729fa194b124d14752e8b7`).
   It uses the same key as the previous version, so it updates over it. Saves are in the app data folder
   `Android/data/org.afedecomp.dobutsunomori/files/save/`.
5. If the app ends abnormally, the next launch shows a window with the cause before the game starts. Tap
   **복사** (Copy) and paste it into an issue (it is also kept as `crash_prev.txt`). **게임 시작** (Start game)
   starts the game as usual.

**Switching to Korean** (all three platforms)
1. Pause menu (Esc on PC, the Back button on Android) → Settings → **Disc** → **Korean patch: Install**
2. Select the downloaded Korean patch zip as it is (file picker on Windows and Android; on Linux, put the zip in the
   game folder's `patch/`).
3. When it finishes (about a second), choose **Restart now**. The original disc image is not changed; a separate
   Korean image is created in `korean/`. Switch back and forth with **Korean: On / Off** on the same tab.

**Default keys (PC)**: move W/A/S/D, A button Space, B button Left Shift, X and Y, Start Enter, Z, L Q, R E,
C-stick arrow keys, D-pad I/J/K/L, town map M. Change them under pause menu → Settings → Controls → Buttons; gamepads
work too. On Korean text-entry screens, type Hangul on a real keyboard with the Dubeolsik (2-set) layout (switch with
the 한/영 key, Right Alt or Shift+Space).

## Verified

- This version, in the game (automated input scripts, new game → town):
  - Linux 32/64-bit: the minimap shows only in the town and hides during the first day's introduction, in buildings and
    in talks. M and a click open and close the map in a 640×480 window; in a 1280×720 window with the touch pad, a tap
    opens it, a tap elsewhere closes it, and dragging from the minimap steers. The asset-free 64-bit release build reads
    all 17693 assets from the disc.
  - Windows 64/32-bit (Wine): the same script, minimap and map opening and closing; both builds give the same screens.
  - Automatic updates: with test copies changed to claim version 0.1.5, the Linux 64-bit build and the Windows 64-bit
    build (Wine) found v0.1.6, downloaded and checked it, installed it and restarted into it. The replaced files are
    removed at the next start.
  - Android: the release-key signature (certificate checked), both ABIs and the permissions. It was not run on an
    emulator or a device this time.
- Verified in earlier versions: new game (Korean name and town name entry) → save → continue, the whole of Nook's
  part-time job, letters and replies, K.K. song requests, house expansion / second floor / basement, round trip to the
  island, building interiors, seasonal events, Redd's tent, the Reset Center, all 15 Famicom games, a week in a single
  run, 64/32-bit screen comparisons, the Windows builds under Wine, Android in an emulator (disc reading, opening,
  installing the Korean patch).

## Known limitations

- The SD card, GBA link and Card e-Reader are treated as "no device" (the game ends each with its own message).
- Not yet tested much on real Windows or Android devices. On Android, the minimap's tap and the automatic update were
  not checked on a device for this version.
- Villagers do not reply to letters with more than a few words of Korean (the Korean patch keeps the code that
  decides this with the Japanese word table; the same happens on a GameCube).
- A save made with the Japanese version and loaded with the Korean-patched disc shows the names stored in the save
  mixed with Hangul characters (the same happens on a GameCube).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
